mapper.sql: id, HEX(notify_hash) notify_hash_hex, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, state, HEX(owner_token) owner_token_hex, fence_token, lease_until, attempt_count, last_error_code
mapper.insert: insert ignore into wx_payment_callback_inbox (notify_hash, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, state, fence_token, attempt_count, create_time, update_time) values (UNHEX(#{notifyHash}), #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{eventType}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: select from wx_payment_callback_inbox where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash})
select from wx_payment_callback_inbox where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) for update
mapper.update: update wx_payment_callback_inbox set state = 1, owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}), fence_token = fence_token + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 60 SECOND), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, update_time = NOW(3) where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) and (state in (0, 3) or (state = 1 and lease_until <= NOW(3)))
mapper.select: select from wx_payment_callback_inbox where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken} and lease_until > NOW(3) for update

choose.when: select id from cms_registration where id = #{bizId} for update
select id from refund_application where id = #{bizId} for update
select id from member_cash_withdraw where id = #{bizId} for update

mapper.update: update wx_payment_callback_inbox set state = 2, lease_until = null, update_time = NOW(3) where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken}

update wx_payment_callback_inbox set state = 4, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_until = null, update_time = NOW(3) where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken}

update wx_payment_callback_inbox set state = 3, owner_token = null, lease_until = null, update_time = NOW(3) where notify_hash = UNHEX(#{notifyHash}) and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken}
